newsitem.title: USA: Wall St stocks open mixed, Dow a trace lower.
newsitem.headline: Wall St stocks open mixed, Dow a trace lower.

text.p: U.S. stocks opened mixed on Monday, with quiet trading expected during the holiday week.
The Dow Industrials opened off two points at 6,482. The Nasdaq Composite rose 1.44 to 1,290.0, while the S&P Index was almost unchanged at 748.
By the time Wall Street opened the 30-year bond was up 7/32 to yield 6.59 percent.
